flows.case: One order: a row of ordering.orders (Ordering.Infrastructure/EntityConfigurations/OrderEntityTypeConfiguration.cs:7; Ordering.Infrastructure/Migrations/OrderingContextModelSnapshot.cs:155-189)
flows.starts: The order's record is written in Submitted: Ordering.API/Application/Commands/CreateOrderCommandHandler.cs:40-51 (new Order, Add, SaveEntitiesAsync), status set at Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/Order.cs:57, committed by Ordering.API/Application/Behaviors/TransactionBehavior.cs:47
flows.ends: The customer has the goods: the order is delivered. The code's last recorded state is Shipped (Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/Order.cs:130-140; Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/OrderStatus.cs:12); the stretch to delivery is added from the reference model (ST4). Or definitively not: the order is Cancelled, for lack of stock (Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/Order.cs:155-168), a failed payment or the customer's request (Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/Order.cs:142-153)

items.why: a checkout that reaches Ordering API and writes no order leaves the customer with no order and, on the web front end, an emptied basket and the orders page, so the customer is not told (lifecycle L01, recovery not created; WebApp/Services/BasketState.cs:107-108; WebApp/Components/Pages/Checkout/Checkout.razor:111-116). items.measure: Orders past the acceptance time limit, by state
items.watches: How many orders have waited longer than the time limit to be accepted, and in which state are they held?
guards: proposed: the order is accepted when the shopper expects, and not lost to a payment outage
items.why: an order still in Submitted, AwaitingValidation or StockConfirmed past the time limit has not been accepted when the shopper expects, and the moves out of AwaitingValidation and StockConfirmed strand it with nothing to move it again (lifecycle L04-L07, recovery stranded)

items.measure: Orders cancelled in acceptance because payment failed
items.watches: How many orders entering acceptance are cancelled because payment failed?
guards: proposed: the order is accepted when the shopper expects, and not lost to a payment outage
items.why: a payment outage cancels every order that reaches StockConfirmed (L07), and none of them waits, so M13 stays flat while the shopper loses the order

items.measure: Shipped orders not confirmed delivered within the expected time
items.watches: How many shipped orders have not reached the customer within the time they expect?
guards: proposed: a shipped order reaches the customer
items.why: a shipped order not delivered within the expected time leaves the customer without the goods they expect (the flow's promise to deliver the goods). The record this alert needs does not exist yet: the code records nothing after Shipped, so a per-order delivery confirmation must be added before it can fire. The bound is the customer's expected delivery time, which no source states and the code sets no time limit for (the customer's expectation of delivery, and the stage's own bounds). Its runbook entry has no tests, and that is the finding, not an omission: tests come from the failures of the move a stage's cases wait on, and these wait on delivery, which no part of the application carries out (step 13 has no lifecycle row; the code's last state is Shipped, Ordering.Domain/AggregatesModel/OrderAggregate/OrderStatus.cs:12). The stage's one recorded move, L14, tells webhook subscribers and does not move an order. Its cases go to the carrier, outside this runbook, until a delivery move and its record are added
